note: The scripted Kolín afternoon (historical orders at historical times), exported from KOLIN_ORDERS in tests/kriegsspiel/kolin_afternoon.py; sources for the plan in docs/kolin-test-pack.md (KRO, Duffy). Manstein's early wheel into the Croats of Chocenice at about 14:30 is the historical departure from the King's plan; the 13:15 order is the King's answer to Zieten's request for a clearer objective.

orders.text: Hülsen, march east along the Kaiserstrasse past Chocenice and storm Křečhoř, then hold the village.
Tresckow, follow Hülsen with the left wing infantry along the road and support his attack on Křečhoř.
Zieten, take the hussars against Nádasdy's horse beyond Kutlíře and drive them off the flank of the advance.
Bevern, keep the right wing in column on the Kaiserstrasse behind Tresckow and do not engage the Austrian front.
The heavy artillery will unlimber by the Zlaté Slunce inn and bombard the Křečhoř heights.
Zieten, ride with the hussars to Kutlíře and charge the Austrian hussars you find there.
Manstein, wheel right at once and clear the Croats out of Chocenice.
The whole army stands fast where it is on the heights; nobody is to descend to pursue.
Nádasdy, take your cavalry against the Prussian hussars beyond Kutlíře and keep them off our right at Křečhoř.
Feuerstein, the artillery will bombard the Prussian columns on the Kaiserstrasse.
Colloredo, march the reserve at once to Křečhoř and hold the village and the oak wood.
